2609.24894.title: SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models
2609.24894.paper_summary: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.
2609.24894.paper_summary_zh: 整張幻燈片病理圖像（WSIs）包含千億像素級別的視覺內容，這對於幻燈片級別的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）造成了重大擴展挑戰。現有的方法處理成千上萬的補丁標記，並通常僅在幻燈片編碼後應用壓縮，這使得多模態注意力計算成本高昂。我們介紹了SLICEChat，一種在混合Mamba-Transformer幻燈片編碼器中整合漸進式標記修剪的幻燈片級MLLM。Mamba層實現了高效的長距離傳播，而Transformer層在序列逐漸縮短的過程中保留全局交互。在不同階段之間，語言監督的區域感知修剪在受控的保留率計劃下去除空間上連貫的低效區域，在多模態融合之前生成緊湊的幻燈片表示。在SlideBench VQA上，SLICEChat在TCGA和BCNB隊列上分別達到了79.84%和59.09%的準確率，超越了之前的幻燈片級病理MLLMs，並在WSI-Bench的整體指標中達到了最高水平。它還在評估的模型中提供了競爭性的內存使用和推理延遲。這些結果展示了對千億像素WSIs的準確且計算高效的多模態推理。
